request.style: English, Coptic Orthodox hymn, a male cantor with long ornamented phrases answered by a choir of deacons, hand cymbals and triangle in a slow steady beat, ancient Egyptian church mode, solemn and tender, 72 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
An angel of the Lord appeared to Joseph in a dream
Rise, take the child and his mother
And flee into Egypt
Stay there until I tell you

[Chorus]
Out of Egypt I called my son
Out of Egypt I called my son

[Verse]
He rose and took the child and his mother by night
And went down into Egypt
And there they stayed
Blessed be Egypt, where the Lord came

[Chorus]
Out of Egypt I called my son
Out of Egypt I called my son
